steps.content: You follow the conspicuous, wide footprints in the snow all the way into the manor's pine forest, but the trail vanishes abruptly in a clearing.

The footprints are clearly shaped and deeply imprinted, yet they neither continue nor change direction ahead in the snow. Your target definitely didn't go far. They might even be using the terrain to hide somewhere nearby, watching you.
Suddenly, a sound comes from ahead to the left. The soft snapping of a dead branch broken by the weight of the snow.
You immediately look up and catch sight of a pine branch trembling gently. You steady your breathing and move closer toward that shadowy part of the forest.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: You have fled here after someone just died in the manor. Are you too afraid to show yourself?
No one answers. But in the shadows to your right, a blurred silhouette streaks past the trees at incredible speed, stirring up a sharp whistle of wind.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I've already read the Red Plum Denunciation. With parts one and two complete, who is your next target?

You raise your voice with feigned casualness while you activate the shackles in your palm. You carefully weigh the risk of exposing your identity as you back against an old pine, using its trunk for cover. The sound of rushing wind grows more urgent, drawing closer.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: All this skulking around... Are you scared of getting exposed? Or am I the third target?
Almost immediately, that sharp whistle of wind suddenly erupts behind you!
[Shackles]

You throw yourself against the tree trunk instantly, using the cascade of snow as cover before spinning around and unleashing the piercing spikes from your shackles. But as you turn, you finally get a clear look at your attacker.
Take this!
You snuff out the shackles narrowly. But through the swirling snow, a wooden stick is already being swung down square on your head.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Ouch...

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Huh?! What are you doing here?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I'm just about to ask you that. Shouldn't you be sleeping in your room? Why did you come here?

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: I was trying to! I was dozing off when I suddenly spotted a suspicious shadow moving past my window!

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: When I went to check on you, you were gone! I was worried something might happen to a scrawny creature like you, so I rushed out to find and save you!
You touch your forehead. Surprisingly, it hasn't swollen up. You're not in the mood to debate who's actually scrawnier, given how weak that hit was, but you catch the crucial detail in her words.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: A suspicious shadow? There was just an incident at the manor, and all the martial heroes were gathered in the front yard. What did this shadow look like?

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Something big and... furry, moving really fast. It looked like... like a big cat? No, no, way bigger than a cat. Those legs were as thick as the diameter of a bowl...
Thick as the diameter of a bowl... Doesn't that match the size of the tracks you've been following?

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Oh, right!
Her eyes suddenly light up as she points toward the snowy ground.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Just like this!
There in the snow lies a set of deep tracks left by a beast, the menacing marks clearly carved by some razor-sharp claws.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But the footprints ended right at this spot when I followed them here... Wait, something's wrong. Move!

Too late. The drift of snow beside Shuang'er suddenly explodes as a white figure leaps out! When you realize what's happening, she's already been swept away, carving a deep, messy furrow through the snow that stretches yards into the distance.
At the end of the furrow stands a massive, fierce white tiger.

The tiger is abnormally huge, its shoulders and back bulky like a mountain. It holds its head slightly lowered, gripping the back of Shuang'er's collar in its jaws, its razor-sharp fangs mere inches from her throat.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: What... what is this thing?!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Don't move... Keep your breathing steady. Don't provoke it.
You quickly examine the tiger's build and claws, comparing them with the wounds on the second victim and the tracks. Everything matches perfectly.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I didn't get a chance to tell you earlier. The Scholar is dead, and this second case might be connected to this white tiger. I'm still not sure if this creature here has anything to do with the manor master. So don't make any sudden moves.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Easy for you to say! I'd rather you hadn't told me that...

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Ma! Pa! Auntie Wang! Mountain God! Help me! I don't want to be eaten!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Quiet! The more you struggle, the fresher and tastier you'll seem, and the sooner it'll eat you.
The little rascal is right. My Meowy has quite the temper, and those claws are not used to handling delicate things. You'd better behave.

A languid, insouciant voice drifts near out of nowhere. You immediately snap to attention, eyes rapidly scanning the surrounding pine forest and snowy slopes, but there's not a soul in sight. You couldn't mistake that familiar accent, but...

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Why would she be here?

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: I-I-I-I remember you! White Tiger Mountain Lord! Please let me go, good Mountain Lord! May your fortune be as vast as the East Sea and your life as enduring as the Southern Mountains...

You scan your surroundings warily, trying to pinpoint the source of the voice, but Xiaofeng doesn't show herself. Only that teasing voice remains, as if woven into the wind itself, drifting leisurely from every direction.

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: It's no use flattering me. There's nothing but snow in this place. My Meowy is still having her growth spurt, and she's been starving. Now that she's finally found herself a nice piece of meat, how could I convince her to let go?

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: The Mountain Lord sounds like she has other demands.

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: Mmm, you get it! I always take a shine to clever ones like you. Alright, I pick you. Entertain me.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Entertain you? How?

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: The mountain path is completely blocked, and the boredom is killing me. I require some proper entertainment. Spar with me, just three rounds. You win, you can take this little beggar with you.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: Wh-what kind of joke is this?! He, he can't do it! Can we play a different game, Mountain Lord? Please, I'm begging you...
steps.female_content: Wh-what kind of joke is this?! She, she can't do it! Can we play a different game, Mountain Lord? Please, I'm begging you...

steps.content: With each breath, the nape of Shuang'er's neck nearly brushes against the tiger's fangs. Her face is deathly pale, yet she strains to turn her head and manages to squeeze out a whisper.

steps.speaker: Shuang'er
steps.content: You can't win against her... We, we can't both die here... You go... Go find help...
There's no help coming. But if the second murder case is truly connected to this Mountain Lord, this might be your closest chance at the truth.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Alright, I'll entertain you.
Both Shuang'er and the Mountain Lord lurking in the shadows seem taken aback by your answer.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: But I'm sure the Mountain Lord would prefer a fair game. Giving me back this girl you took from me hardly counts as a prize. If I win, I should get some other reward.

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: Oh? You wish to ask for something? Go ahead, I can be quite generous.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: If I win, tell me everything you know about the Scholar's death.
The figure in the shadows takes a deep breath, clearly satisfied with what you've proposed.

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: So you came here following the "copper smell." Well then, I certainly have plenty to tell you.

steps.speaker: Mountain Lord
steps.content: Come on, Meowy, time for a game!
